mission.name: Rooftop Uplink
mission.description: Upload the data at the east uplink, then extract from the enemy roof (top-left).

unit.name: Drone A
unit.script: message("Drones on the east roof. They fly over walls!");

zone.label: UPLINK
zone.script: set_flag("uplink", 1); message("Data uploaded! Now extract from the enemy roof (top-left).");

zone.label: EXTRACTION
zone.script: if flag("uplink") == 1 { evac(zone_count("extraction", "player"), alive_count("player"), "Everyone aboard. Extraction!"); } else { message("Upload the data at the uplink first."); }

mission.script: message("Upload at the east uplink, then extract from the top-left roof.");
if round == 2 { spawn_unit("enemy", "drone", "Drone C", 14, 7); message("Another drone joins the fight."); }
if flag("uplink") == 1 && alive_count("player") > 0 && zone_count("extraction", "player") >= alive_count("player") { message("Everyone aboard. Extraction!"); win(); }
